model_selection_rule: Do not conflate technical score or accumulated buys and SOL curve reserve with prediction. Favor timely, independently refreshable research rather than assume old highest-score leads remain active. With no current as-of price, sell pressure, distinct wallet evidence, organic/social evidence or security/realistic quote, no BUY or SELL. WATCH means request more information, not a buy signal.
